primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events and treatment-emergent laboratory abnormalities through Week 24 plus 30 days.
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 72.7%–90.5% across regimens; serious AEs affected 0/22–1/21 participants, with no deaths. Laboratory-abnormality percentages were reported, but the supplied summary does not identify what each set of values represents.
